name: P1-A metric-refined cross-task generalization
purpose: Run the Item115 metric-refinement addendum for P1-A: decouple exact-CBJ decision quality and A/C cost from solve mid-band Gate-3. Using the verified Gate-2 solver, collect nontrivial backjump decision points, run C1 zero-shot BACKJUMP targeting on futoshiki and 9x9 sudoku, and measure A-vs-C token growth on verified traces. n_queens has zero nontrivial CBJ decision points under the current row-as-variable formulation and is not read for exact-CBJ.

provenance.spec: user SPEC Overnight Batch v0 Addendum Item115, P1-A metric refinement

code_added_used.change: Adds decision-preflight, reason-metric, and cost-metric commands on top of the verified Gate-2 solver.

commands.command: decision-preflight for futoshiki size7 difficulty3, sudoku 9x9, and n_queens N12 remove-max
commands.purpose: Check enough nontrivial CBJ decision points before reason/cost reads.

commands.command: reason-metric for futoshiki and sudoku, max_points=80, nontrivial_only, Qwen3 fp32
commands.purpose: Measure zero-shot C1 exact-CBJ decision quality on nontrivial cross-task dead-ends.
Measure A-vs-C token growth by depth on selected multi-source verified trace prefixes.

headline.decision_precondition: futoshiki and sudoku have enough nontrivial points; n_queens has 3253 decision points but 0 nontrivial, so exact-CBJ is trivial/not readable for n_queens under row-as-variable formulation.
headline.futoshiki_reason: parse_rate=1.0, valid_rate=1.0, exact_cbj_rate=0.075 vs chrono_exact_rate=0.0 on 80 nontrivial points.
headline.sudoku_reason: parse_rate=1.0, valid_rate=1.0, exact_cbj_rate=0.0125 vs chrono_exact_rate=0.0 on 80 nontrivial points.
headline.cost: A-vs-C token growth generalizes strongly on selected multi-source trace prefixes: futoshiki reaches max-depth C/A=478.23x and sudoku reaches max-depth C/A=121.85x.
headline.single_next_move: Report cross-task cost generalization as positive, but do not claim C1 exact-CBJ reason generalization from this prompt. Improve task-specific reason prompts or scoring before any positive reason claim.

gate_outcomes.number: C/A grows steeply with depth for futoshiki and sudoku; final prefix-bounded multi-source rows use 2 futoshiki source traces and 5 sudoku source traces.

decision.next_step_routing: For P1-A, quote cost generalization but not reason generalization. For reason, inspect wrong predictions and redesign task-specific prompts before rerun.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish cross-task C1 reason generalization. The model follows format but chooses the wrong target on most nontrivial futoshiki/sudoku points.
honesty.cost_limit: Cost is tokenizer/context accounting on selected multi-source verified symbolic trace prefixes, not a full live-KV cache replay per task.
honesty.n_queens_limit: n_queens row-variable formulation yields zero nontrivial chrono-vs-CBJ target differences, so exact-CBJ is not a meaningful metric there without a different formulation.
